content.comment_body: Hello, Were you able to solve this? I'm just starting out and seem to be stuck. I'm trying to read the analog value from AI3 using Node-RED, but I always get a value of 0. Is there something I'm missing or doing incorrectly?
You are using the incorrect address. AI1 = 1032, AI2 = 1034, AI3 = 1036, AI4 = 1038, AI5 = 1040, AI6 = 1042, AI7 = 1044, AI8 = 1046.
Glad to hear that everything is working now.

Correcting the address allowed successful data reading, emphasizing the necessity of accurate address assignment when working with third-party integrations.
